says: Four decision records on main carry an unquoted title that holds ': ', so their frontmatter does not parse as YAML, though records.ts's line-by-line reader accepts it. The rules and records build reads a record's status from frontmatter that yaml has parsed (its plan, line 108), so its records check would fail on these four. Ticket text: quote the title of .decisions/0099, 0105, 0255 and 0582 in the cleanup slice that owns each number, or have slice 8's check name an unparseable frontmatter as its own finding with the file and line.
proof: `python3 -c` with `yaml.safe_load` over the frontmatter of .decisions/0099-no-number-caps-a-pull-request.md, 0105-a-durable-object-never-stays-awake-on-its-own.md, 0255-every-npm-version-is-exact.md and 0582-mail-as-a-noun-goes-it-is-a-mailbox-and-messages.md fails on each, at its line 3 `title:`; `grep -l '^title: [^"].*: ' .decisions/*.md` lists those four (and 0565 on the slice 5 branch); docs/plan/quests/rules-and-records-build-PLAN.md:108 reads status 'from frontmatter that `yaml` has parsed'.
cost: Slice 8's or 9's check would fail on records no slice was told to touch, or a tolerant reader would hide a frontmatter that other YAML tools refuse.
